description: Full-text search of wiki.postgresql.org, current text unless history=true (per page its latest matching revision: rev_id, revision_url, author, comment, timestamp, is_current, matches). Operators as in search. A commit SHA returns the pages citing it.

since.description: With history: revisions at or after (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601)

until.description: With history: revisions before the end of this date

name: search_wiki
